# Daily Briefing – Saturday 21 November

Yesterday was a solid rest day, Adam. 8,367 steps kept you nicely active without overdoing it, and burning 2,506 kcal against your 2,300 target gives you a small deficit — exactly what you need tracking toward that 80-85kg goal.

Your HRV at 81ms is sitting below your 90-119ms baseline, which is worth noting. The good news is your resting HR of 52 bpm looks strong and stress at 43/100 is manageable. If today has a hard session planned, consider dialling intensity back 10-15% — your body is whispering rather than shouting, but it's worth listening.

With 7.3 hours of sleep and HRV slightly suppressed, prioritise protein today — hit that 175g target deliberately. A Greek yoghurt and eggs at breakfast gets you a third of the way there before 9am. Simple wins.
